target: local M4 / G16G only (A18 Pro hands-off per CLAUDE.md target discipline)

I.purpose: H1/H2: init-time checkpoint trace, nospill vs spill

B.purpose: H3: deterministic compile-time-ceiling bisection per stage
B.k_high_note: == mesa/src/asahi/lib/agx_scratch.c AGX_MAX_SCRATCH_DWORDS, used as an explicit H3 search target only -- not assumed to apply to Apple9

C.policy: REVISED per PRE_REGISTRATION.md addendum #2: no escalation-stop; every level runs all repeats; only a hard fault (timeout / crash exit) aborts early. Per-trial outcome fields are NONDETERMINISTIC (directly observed during pre-capture reconnaissance) and excluded from the cross-run gate; the per-level failure RATE across repeats is the reported finding.

gated_schema_keys.note: authoritative source is casematrix.py's *_KEYS constants; this block is a human-readable mirror, not the enforced source of truth

excluded_nondeterministic_fields: mach_time (I family checkpoint timestamps -- process-relative monotonic clock, not reproducible run-to-run in exact value; lives only in dumps/*.checkpoints.jsonl and the trace log, never in a gated *_KEYS schema)
any gpu_va / raw address (per EXP-0041/EXP-0107 precedent; resource_map_shape is address-free by construction)
wall-clock timestamps and durations (03_timing.jsonl, explicitly ungated)

C family per-trial status/ok_queues/execfail_queues/nonfinite_queues/checksum_mismatch -- directly observed to vary trial-to-trial at FIXED n_queues during this experiment's own pre-capture reconnaissance (PRE_REGISTRATION.md addendum #2); present in C_TRIAL_KEYS (schema-exactness still enforced) but excluded from C_GATED_TRIAL_KEYS

environment.host: local Apple M4 (G16G), 10 GPU cores, macOS 26.6.2 (25G82), Metal 4
environment.compiler: clang (Xcode Command Line Tools), no external metal CLI
